_description: H6b: Add 3M momentum floor of +15%. Tests whether requiring stocks to have gained at least 15% over the past 3 months (vs current 0% floor) filters weak-momentum setups that fail in bad regimes. Built on baseline_v5 (H1 integrated).
_hypothesis: Bad-regime WR collapses because PEAD setups in choppy markets fail to extend. Stocks with strong recent momentum (3M >= +15%) may have better continuation odds even in volatile regimes, since they have already demonstrated trend strength.
_baseline: Compare to h1_floor_jan_mar and h1_floor_jul_sep. H1 baseline: Jan-Mar +26.0% (WR 57.4%, R:R 2.04, margin +24.5pp) / Jul-Sep +2.3% (WR 38.9%, R:R 2.01, margin +5.6pp).
